source.name: Codex-authored Rhythm And Repetition Word Repetition Development Pilot
source.notes: Synthetic writing authored against the frozen rhythm-and-repetition definitions and the existing hedge-stacking definition where assessed. Reviews and measured results are stored separately.

instructions: Development writing for reviewed judgments and prompt tuning.

snippets: The standard option includes delivery on weekdays. We arrange delivery after confirming your address, and the delivery usually takes two days. Paying for the evening option moves the delivery to after six. You can track the delivery online or call our office if you need to discuss the delivery with someone.

To claim expenses, match each receipt to one card charge. Circle the total on the receipt if tips appear separately. Write the project code on the receipt before scanning it. Upload the receipt beside its matching charge, retain the original receipt until reimbursement, and mark any unreadable receipt for manual review.

The shed has a new lock. Anyone needing the shed can borrow a key from the caretaker, who keeps the shed logbook. Please record when you enter the shed and leave the shed tidy afterward. We are still sorting the shed shelves, so contact us if you cannot find a particular tool.

We can replace the box without replacing its contents. Fold the box flat and bring the box to the counter; the box should fit in an ordinary shopping bag. Our assistant will inspect the box and give you another box while you wait, provided your purchase was within the last month.

Read the header row before assigning columns. Treat each later row as a separate observation. Reject a row with a missing identifier, but retain a row with an empty optional comment. Write the original row number beside each error. This lets the uploader locate the rejected row without counting entries by hand.

Leave the parcel sealed while we investigate. Photograph the parcel beside a ruler so its dimensions are visible. Weigh the parcel with its packaging, then copy the tracking code from the parcel into your reply. Retain the parcel until the courier confirms collection; handing the parcel to a different carrier would interrupt the claim.

The hat was still on the hook when Milo returned. He touched the hat as though the hat might tell him how long his father had been gone. Dust covered the hat brim. Taking the hat down carefully, he put the hat in a paper bag and carried it to the car with the other things.

You can set a reminder from any task. The reminder arrives by email, and the reminder includes a link back to your work. Edit the reminder to choose another time or remove the reminder when plans change. We display the reminder beside the due date so you can check both at once.

I bought the lamp for my desk. The lamp fits beside the monitor, and the lamp gives enough light for paperwork. I can turn the lamp toward the wall when I want softer light. Although the lamp was expensive, I use the lamp every evening.

The workshop is open to beginners. At the workshop you will repair a simple wooden stool, and the workshop includes all tools. We can accommodate twelve people in the workshop, so please book the workshop beforehand. Wear closed shoes to the workshop because there may be splinters on the floor near the benches.

We need a plan for the office move. Our plan should cover packing, and the plan needs to include the equipment cupboard. Please put your suggestions for the plan in the shared document. Once the plan is ready, I will send the plan to facilities so they can arrange access to the loading bay.

The bit tells the reader whether compression was used. We set the bit during encoding, and the decoder checks the bit before opening the body. When the bit is absent, the bit has its default value of zero. Changing the bit after transmission will make the reader interpret the bit incorrectly.

Thanks for sending the receipt. I have attached the receipt to your claim so our assessor can check the receipt tomorrow. The date on the receipt is readable, although the bottom of the receipt is slightly blurred. Please keep the paper receipt until we have confirmed payment to your bank.

My first job involved answering a shared telephone. The job taught me to write names down, and the job made me less afraid to ask someone to repeat a question. I left the job after a year, but the habits from that job stayed with me long after I moved into another job.

Our desk's watchword is "care." We put care into every reply, and care is how we describe the way we answer calls. That care follows callers from greeting to goodbye. I ask new staff to keep care in mind whenever they offer care to someone confused about a bill. Yesterday we added a callback option so callers can speak while holding the statement they need explained.

The headphones are comfortable during my commute. I put the headphones on before boarding, and the headphones make the carriage quieter. After an hour, the headphones still feel light. Charging the headphones overnight gives me enough power for several journeys, so I usually leave the headphones beside my keys when I get home.

A token represents the current session. We create the token after sign-in and save the token in a cookie. The browser sends the token with later requests so the server can recognize the token. Signing out removes the token, and the next visit requires another sign-in before private pages will open.

The crossing will close during resurfacing. Signs beside the crossing will direct pedestrians to the next crossing near the bakery. Work at the crossing starts at seven, and the crossing should reopen before school finishes. Please allow extra time if the crossing forms part of your usual route to the station.

The monthly service includes a report after each visit. That report arrives by email, and you can also find the report in your account. The annual service supplies a report in the same way. Whichever option you choose, the report describes the work completed and the report gives you a record to keep for your landlord.

This jacket was a birthday present. The jacket fits over a jumper, and the jacket has pockets deep enough for gloves. I wore the jacket in drizzle yesterday and stayed dry. Although the jacket cost more than I usually spend, the jacket has already become the thing I reach for before leaving home.

The experiment used a small water tank. We ran the experiment in the laboratory, where the experiment could be watched by the whole class. After the experiment, students drew what they remembered. Repeating the experiment gave them time to correct their drawings and discuss the experiment with a partner before writing conclusions.

The hall will reopen on Monday. Visitors to the hall can use the side entrance while the hall roof is being repaired. We have moved the hall noticeboard beside that entrance, where you can check the hall timetable. Please contact the caretaker if you need help finding your group inside the hall.

We paused your subscription as requested. During the pause, the subscription remains visible in your account, but the subscription will generate no charges. To restart the subscription, select Resume beside the subscription. I have also attached instructions explaining how to close the subscription if your plans change before September.

Your refund has been approved, and the refund should arrive on Friday. We sent the refund to your original card because that is where our refund system directs it. If the refund has not appeared by Monday, reply here so I can ask finance to trace the refund for you.

I listened to the recording of a support call this morning. Listening revealed a question I had missed while I listened live. We need to listen before assuming we understand, and listening takes more patience than I expected. Next week I will listen to another call with the colleague who handled it.

Generate a preview after choosing the recipient group. Check the preview for a sample recipient, then switch the preview to a recipient whose name includes accents. Download that preview for sign-off. Regenerate the preview after any template edit, since approval applies to the saved preview rather than to later changes in the editor.

The variable records household income. We added the variable to the model after checking the variable for missing values. Because the variable was skewed, we transformed the variable before estimation. The appendix describes the variable in more detail and explains how we collected it from the forms returned by participants.

The weekly course includes one session on Saturday. You can attend the session online, and a recording of the session stays available afterward. The intensive course adds a second session on Sunday. Each session lasts an hour, giving you time to ask questions before the session ends and the tutor signs off.

The collection takes place on Friday. Put items out before the collection begins at eight, and keep the collection area clear of parked cars. We will postpone the collection if high winds make the collection unsafe. Check the council page on Thursday evening for confirmation that the collection will go ahead.

Your ticket is with our repairs team. I added a photograph to the ticket and marked the ticket urgent. You can open the ticket from your email, where the ticket link remains active for a month. Replying there updates the ticket automatically.

Both packages include a visit each month. During the visit, a cleaner handles the kitchen, and the visit can include the stairs if time allows. You can move the visit by calling us. The longer package extends the visit by an hour, giving you more time to add tasks to the visit.

This update introduces a tab for archived projects. The tab appears beside Active, and the tab contains everything you have archived. Select the tab to browse older work or search within the tab. We retain your place in the tab when you open a project and return to the tab afterward.

Her suitcase came off the belt last. One wheel on the suitcase had broken, forcing her to drag the suitcase across the tiled floor. She opened the suitcase beside the exit to find her coat. With the suitcase finally closed again, she carried the suitcase outside, where her brother was waiting beside a borrowed van.

The bus will leave at nine. Please wait beside the bus stop sign until the bus arrives. We have hired a bus with space for walking frames, and the bus driver can help with boarding. Bring your ticket to the bus so we can check everyone is aboard before the bus departs.

The fee covers an initial consultation. We collect the fee when you book, and the fee appears on your confirmation. Either adviser charges the same fee for this first meeting. If you continue afterward, we deduct the fee from your next invoice so the fee becomes part of your overall payment.

The package includes two cleaning visits. We designed the package for smaller flats, although the package can cover a house if you book extra time. Choosing the package gives you a regular cleaner. You can pause the package online or cancel the package by phone.

The roster is ready for next month. I built the roster around the availability you sent, but the roster still needs someone for Sunday morning. Check the roster today and tell me if the roster clashes with your leave. I will print the roster tomorrow for the staff room noticeboard.

I ordered the blanket for the sofa. The blanket is soft enough against bare skin, and the blanket reaches my feet when I sit down. Our cat likes the blanket too. After washing, the blanket dried overnight without losing its shape, so I am pleased with the blanket despite the slightly darker color.

We changed the schedule after asking staff about commuting. The schedule now starts half an hour later, and the schedule leaves lunch unchanged. People can see the schedule on the office door. I will review the schedule next month, though the schedule already seems easier for colleagues taking the early train.

Both memberships let you borrow a car. You choose the car in the app, collect the car from a nearby bay, and unlock the car with your phone. When you finish, return the car to its original bay. The cheaper membership costs less each month but charges more for each hour with the car.

The interview lasted forty minutes. We recorded the interview with permission and transcribed the interview the following day. Reading the interview helped us identify questions for the next participant. We stored the interview under a code, keeping names separate so the interview could be shared with the research team during analysis.

The market returns to the square on Sunday. At the market you can buy vegetables and bread from local growers. We have moved the market entrance nearer the crossing, and the market will have extra bins. Please bring a bag to the market and leave the market clear for traders packing up at two.

The export now includes comments. Start an export from the toolbar, then wait for the export to finish before closing the window. A completed export appears in Downloads with the export date in its filename. If the export fails, a message explains how to try again without losing your selection.

Approach the crossing from the pavement, keeping the pram behind the kerb. At this crossing the cycle lane comes before the road, so check both separately. Use the crossing button once, wait inside the marked crossing area, and follow the pedestrian signal. Report a damaged crossing light using the number printed on the crossing pole.

I have uploaded the agenda for Thursday. Please read the agenda before lunch and add any suggestions to the agenda comments. The agenda is shorter this week because two presenters are away. Once everyone has checked the agenda, I will send the agenda to the visitors so they know when to join us.

Please send your handover by four. The handover should mention unfinished requests, and the handover can include links to any relevant files. We will read the handover before the evening shift begins. If you need to amend the handover later, put a dated note at the top of the handover.

The kettle arrived on Tuesday. I like how the kettle looks on the counter, and the kettle boils enough water for our morning tea. Filling the kettle is easy because the kettle has a wide lid. After a fortnight, I am happy with the kettle and would buy it again for a small kitchen.

The cursor records your position in the results. Sending the cursor with another request lets the server continue from the cursor. We encode the cursor before returning it, and the client stores the cursor until you scroll again. An expired cursor produces an error asking you to obtain a new cursor.

Each worker processes uploaded photographs. A worker takes the next photograph when the worker finishes the current one. We start another worker during busy periods, and the worker stops after ten idle minutes. The dashboard displays the worker count so an operator can see whether another worker is needed.

A useful review starts with listening. During a review, people need space to explain their choices. The review then becomes a chance to understand what happened, rather than a formality. I now leave more time for each review because a rushed review rarely gives the team enough room to discuss what the next review should cover.

The letter arrived after breakfast. She put the letter beside her plate, wondering whether the letter contained the decision she expected. Only after washing up did she open the letter. The paper inside the letter was thin, and she held the letter against the window to read the faint ink.

The bridge appeared through the mist as they rounded the bend. Sam remembered the bridge from childhood, though the bridge seemed narrower now. Weeds grew between the bridge stones. Halfway across the bridge he paused to look down at the stream, then left the bridge behind and followed the path toward the mill.

The radio crackled from the kitchen shelf. Tom turned the radio down so he could hear the kettle, then turned the radio up when a familiar voice began the weather forecast. He had repaired the radio the previous winter. Now the radio kept him company each morning while the radio casing slowly yellowed in the sun.

The client retries when a connection drops. It retries after a short pause, then retries again if the server remains unavailable. Retrying gives the server time to recover, but the client stops retrying after a minute. A user can retry manually from the error page if they still need the file.

The garden opens again this weekend. Visitors can enter the garden from the lane, where a volunteer will hand out the garden leaflet. We have added benches to the garden and repaired the garden fence. Please keep dogs on leads while walking through the garden so seedlings beside the path remain undisturbed.

A row stores a single reading. The row includes a timestamp, and the row also carries a sensor number. We write the row after checking that the row contains a valid temperature. If validation fails, the row goes into a separate file where an operator can inspect it later.

The filter now accepts several departments. Add departments to the filter using the menu beneath the filter name. Clearing the filter restores all results, while closing the filter leaves your selection intact. We also show the active filter above the list so colleagues can understand the view when you share your screen.

I washed the cover before using it. It washes well at thirty degrees, and washing removes the smell from the packaging. I have washed it twice since then. The label says to wash it separately, which I did, and I will keep washing it that way because the red dye ran the first time.

Our basic plan includes storage for your photographs. The storage is online, so you can reach the storage from any device. Upgrading adds more storage without changing how the storage works. Families often choose the larger plan because the storage gives everyone somewhere to keep pictures from their phones.

The queue receives documents for conversion. Documents stay in the queue until a machine takes them from the queue. We check the queue every few seconds and show the queue length on the status page. When demand rises, adding a machine helps drain the queue before customers begin to notice delays.

The new drawer keeps your attachments within reach. Open the drawer from the paperclip icon; the drawer slides in from the right. You can leave the drawer open while composing, and the drawer remembers its width. We have also made the drawer available on tablets for people who write away from their desks.

Lena found the umbrella beneath the bench. Rain dripped from the umbrella onto her shoes as she carried the umbrella toward the ticket office. Someone had tied a ribbon around the umbrella handle. She left the umbrella with the clerk, hoping its owner would ask there before buying another umbrella for the journey home.

The chapter introduces coastal erosion. Early in the chapter, readers encounter photographs of a retreating cliff. The chapter then describes wave action, and the chapter ends with questions for discussion. We designed the chapter for first-year students, keeping the chapter short enough to read before a two-hour laboratory session.

I liked the bag as soon as I unpacked it. The bag has a wide opening, and the bag feels comfortable on my shoulder. After a week, the bag still looks new. I take the bag on the train every morning, and I would recommend the bag to anyone carrying a laptop and a few books.

I found your parcel at the depot. The parcel missed yesterday's van because the label on the parcel was damaged. Staff have given the parcel a new label, so the parcel can travel tonight. You should receive a message when the driver puts the parcel on tomorrow's route.

I bought the mat for our back door. The mat catches most of the mud, and the mat stays in place when the dog runs over it. Cleaning the mat takes a quick shake outside. I wish the mat were wider, but the mat fits the narrow space without catching beneath the door.

The brochure promises "support." We provide support by telephone, with support available on weekdays. Your package gives you support whenever you call during those hours. We describe this support as part of the membership because support is what members expect when a machine stops. Both plans include the same number for speaking to an adviser.

The sidebar now holds saved views. Opening the sidebar displays your folders, and the sidebar remembers which folder you last opened. You can resize the sidebar by dragging its edge. Closing the sidebar preserves your selection, so the sidebar is ready when you return.

The cache holds recent responses so the cache can return them quickly. Each entry in the cache has an expiry time stored beside it in the cache. When that time passes, the cache removes the entry. A later request gives the cache an opportunity to fetch a fresh response from the upstream server.

A consultation is included with either package. The consultation lasts forty minutes, and you can have the consultation by video. We send notes after the consultation so you can remember what the consultation covered. If you need another consultation, reception can arrange one at the same rate next month.

The map shows the valley at the end of the survey. We drew the map from field notes and placed the map beside the photographs. Students can use the map to locate the terraces. The map also marks the stream, making the map a useful starting point for discussing where sediment accumulated.

The pan heats evenly on our hob. I made eggs in the pan yesterday, and nothing stuck to the pan. The handle keeps the pan comfortable to lift, even when the pan is full. I dry the pan immediately after washing because the instructions say that leaving water inside can stain the surface.

The desk by the window is available. Anyone using the desk should wipe the desk afterward and leave the desk clear for the next person. There is a charger beneath the desk if you need one. Let me know if the desk chair needs adjusting before your first shift here.

You can rent either model for the weekend. Renting includes a helmet, and you can rent a child seat separately. We rent both models from the same counter, where staff explain the brakes before you rent. Customers who rented last summer can use their old account to rent again this year.

The bicycle is easy to carry upstairs. I chose the bicycle because the bicycle folds beside the lift, where our building has little storage. Riding the bicycle feels steady on smooth roads. The bicycle struggles on cobbles, but for my short trip to work the bicycle has been a convenient choice.

The module receives sensor readings. We load the module during startup and give the module a directory for temporary files. Inside the module, a timer triggers processing; after processing, the module deletes those files. A log records when the module finishes.

They walked beside the canal after supper. Walking gave them something to do while they decided what to say. At the bridge they were still walking, though neither usually walked so far. They walked past the closed shop and kept walking until the towpath lights came on and the first easy conversation of the evening began.

We moved the deadline back by two days. The deadline had left no time for checking, and the deadline was encouraging people to submit work before it was ready. Explaining the deadline helped the client accept the change. We met the revised deadline with fewer corrections than we had expected under the original deadline.

I shortened our meeting by removing updates people could read beforehand. The meeting now begins with a decision, and the meeting ends when that decision is recorded. People still prepare for the meeting, but the meeting no longer consumes the whole morning. Our first shorter meeting left time to carry out what we had agreed.

The worksheet introduces equivalent fractions. Students receive the worksheet before the lesson and bring the worksheet to their groups. We put an example at the top of the worksheet so they can begin without waiting. The worksheet has space for drawings, and students retain the worksheet for revision.

The tin held her grandmother's buttons. Opening the tin released a faint smell of sewing-machine oil, and she rested the tin on her knee. Beneath the tin lid was a faded address. She copied it before closing the tin, then put the tin back in the drawer where her mother expected to find it.

We will plant along the fence on Saturday. Anyone who enjoys planting can join us, and we will plant even if it drizzles. Last year we planted the entrance beds; this year we are planting the shaded boundary. Bring gloves if you plan to plant, as the soil contains small stones and old roots.

Our printer arrived with clear instructions. Setting up the printer took ten minutes, and the printer found the wireless network immediately. I have used the printer for school forms all week. The printer is louder than expected, but the printer fits on the shelf and produces sharp text on inexpensive paper.

This release adds a panel for saved searches. The panel sits beside the results, with a panel header showing the current folder. Inside the panel, you can rename a search or drag it into another folder. Closing the panel preserves your selection, so reopening the panel brings you back to the same place.

The path behind the school is open again. We cleared the path yesterday and spread gravel where the path had become muddy. You can use the path in daylight, but the path still has no lighting. Please tell the caretaker if branches fall across the path after the next spell of windy weather.

Jon waited beside the gate until the gate rattled in the wind. He put his hand against the gate and felt the cold metal. Beyond the gate, the path disappeared into weeds. He had remembered the gate as taller, but now the gate barely reached his shoulder, and he could see the empty house beyond it.

Both courses award a certificate. The certificate arrives by email, and you can print the certificate at home. Our office can post the certificate if you prefer paper. Completing the advanced course gives the certificate a different title, but the certificate uses the same design and includes the date you finished.

The team needed a quieter place to work. We moved the team away from reception, where visitors often interrupted the team. After a week, the team reported fewer unfinished tasks. I wish I had asked the team about the room sooner, because the team had been trying to manage the noise for months.

Students measured the spring at rest, then measured it with a weight attached. Measuring took longer than expected because they measured from different starting points. After agreeing where to measure, they measured again and entered the results in a table. This gave the group a set of readings they could discuss together.

We are arranging training for the reception team. The training will happen next Wednesday, and the training will cover the new booking screen. Please tell me whether you can attend the training. Anyone who misses the training can watch a recording of the training before their next shift starts.

Your booking is visible in our system. The booking includes the breakfast you selected, and the booking shows two guests. To amend the booking, open the booking from your confirmation email. We can also update the booking by phone if you prefer to speak with someone before your arrival.

We have added a badge to unread conversations. The badge appears beside the sender, and the badge disappears when you open the message. You can disable the badge in preferences if the badge distracts you. Changing this preference removes the badge immediately, so there is no need to refresh the page.

Students learn the distinction through examples. As students learn, they begin to notice differences they missed before learning the rule. They learn more through discussion and learn again when they explain an answer to a partner. By learning in this way, students develop the confidence to attempt unfamiliar questions without waiting for the teacher.

Our survey closes on Friday. The survey takes five minutes, and the survey asks about the new timetable. Please complete the survey even if you are satisfied, since the survey needs everyone's views. I will summarize the survey next week and bring the findings to the meeting with operations.

The voucher is valid until December. Use the voucher at checkout by entering the number printed beneath the voucher barcode. If the voucher is rejected, send us a photograph of the voucher and we can check it manually. You can also bring the voucher into the shop for assistance.

We published the budget before choosing equipment. Seeing the budget helped colleagues suggest options within the budget, rather than argue over products beyond the budget. We changed the budget once to cover delivery. That was easier than defending a budget nobody had seen until the budget was already committed to a purchase.

The form is ready for your expenses. Please open the form from the staff page and attach receipts to the form. We send the form to finance on Friday, so check the form before noon. The form remains editable until then.

I checked the cupboard before ordering stationery. Please check your drawers as well, since checking them may turn up spare supplies. We should check what we already have before checking the catalogue. Once everyone has checked, I can place a smaller order and leave some room in this month's budget.

The centre opens on Monday. Visitors to the centre should enter through the courtyard while the centre roof is repaired. We have put the centre timetable beside the entrance, and the caretaker can help you find a class inside the centre. Anyone wishing to volunteer at the centre can leave a number at reception.

The buffer holds incoming measurements until the worker is ready. Values enter the buffer from the socket, and the worker reads the buffer every second. When the buffer fills, new values replace old values in the buffer. We expose the buffer size in settings so operators can give the buffer more room.
